description: Data governance and protection rules — rules for ensuring data usage compliance. Sourced from data_usage_policy.yaml and data_protection_rules.yaml.

entries.title: Finding must have usage approval before processing
entries.description: A finding must have governance.usage_approved = true before it can be reviewed. Findings without explicit usage approval are blocked from the review pipeline to prevent unauthorized data processing.
entries.action: Block review. Return error with reason: 'usage not approved'. Do not process finding.

entries.title: Data must be redacted before training environment upload
entries.description: All data uploaded to Google Colab or any training environment must have redaction applied and verified. The redaction_status must be one of: provider_preprocessed, automated_check_passed, manual_check_passed, or not_applicable.
entries.action: Block upload. Require redaction pipeline completion and verification before any data enters training environment.

entries.title: PII must not appear in SLM prompts or outputs
entries.description: No personally identifiable information (PII) including credentials, email addresses, phone numbers, internal hostnames, or client URLs may appear in SLM prompts or outputs. The redaction pipeline must remove these before processing.
conditions: PII patterns detected in finding text
entries.action: Apply redaction replacements. Verify no PII remains after redaction. If PII detected in prompt: sanitize before SLM call. If PII in output: filter before returning.

entries.title: Test set must be frozen before training and never used in train
entries.description: The test set must be frozen (split by document/engagement, not by finding) before training begins. Training data must never include test set examples. This prevents train-test leakage that would invalidate evaluation results.
conditions: test data found in training set
entries.action: Block training until test set is frozen and verified. Split must be by document/engagement family. Log split verification.
